findings.title: Out-of-phase required-target consumer forbids optional no-move continuation
findings.expected: After declaring and rolling an out-of-phase charge, the player may still choose not to make the Charge move; the source requires a target if a move is made, rather than requiring a move.
findings.actual: The valid no-move proposal (empty targets, no witness) is rejected charge_required_target_not_selected because the generic reactive request requires its selected arrival target. The move/reject/retry/success sibling completes.
findings.qualification: Native Lord Exultant definitions under a constructed compiled generic reactive permission and constructed already-completed arrival boundary; no named faction admission or reserve ingress claim. The permission explicitly suppresses Charge bonus. Ordinary Charge target/proposal declines both pass.
